gloss: to follow (an example), to imitate, to model after

definitions.gloss: to follow an example, to imitate, to model after
definitions.explanation: To take someone or something as a model and act accordingly. Implies deliberate emulation of a good example or established practice.

examples.japanese: {前例|ぜんれい}に{倣|なら}って{対応|たいおう}する。
{他|た}の{国|くに}の{成功例|せいこうれい}に{倣|なら}い、{新|あたら}しい{制度|せいど}を{導入|どうにゅう}した。
examples.english: Following the success of other countries, a new system was introduced.

notes:
{倣|なら}う means to imitate or model oneself after something. Not to be confused with the homophone {習|なら}う (to learn, to take lessons).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし})
- Pattern: 〜に{倣|なら}う

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜に{倣|なら}って: following the example of ~
- 〜に{倣|なら}い: following ~ (more formal/written)
- {前例|ぜんれい}に{倣|なら}う: to follow precedent
- {右|みぎ}に{倣|なら}え: follow the person to the right (line-up command)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {習|なら}う: to learn, to study (different kanji and meaning)
- {真似|まね}る: to mimic, to copy (less deliberate, sometimes negative)
- {倣|なら}う: to follow an example (deliberate, positive connotation)
